meaning: A requires knowledge of B. Only include essential, non-redundant dependencies.
A can be mathematically derived from B.
A is algebraically, differentially, or structurally built from B, without necessarily being derived as a theorem.
A is a component, frame split, or extracted part of B.
A is a concrete example, special case, or named instance of B.
A and B are closely associated, but neither is a prerequisite of the other.
